done_when: One Python helper (e.g. scripts/dev/binance_net.py or MyTradingSys/common) resolves *.binance.com and *.binance.vision via DoH (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, fallback Google 8.8.8.8), caches by TTL, detects the block IP 49.44.79.236 / private answers and never uses them, keeps TLS hostname check (SNI = real name); every Python caller of fapi/fstream/api.binance.com uses it (fetch_bars.py, fetch_futures_metrics.py, live_layers.py, orderflow_live.py and any other grep hit)

Java feed (Java 17: no resolver SPI) reaches wss://fstream.binance.com on a blocked network: use the WebSocket/HTTP library's own DNS hook or connect-to-IP with SNI/Host = real name; no jdk.net.hosts.file that breaks other hosts; fail closed with a clear log line when DoH also fails

Tests written first and shown failing on pre-change code: block IP rejected, DoH fallback order, TTL cache, TLS name kept, DoH-down fails closed, restart/reset state and API-error paths (live-path rule); run_all_tests.py --quick green; Maven tests green

Proof on JIS-NB: a live fapi 4h kline and 30 s of fstream messages through the new path, numbers in Result; broadcast --cmd so JIS-NUC and the laptop run the same smoke; commit Result includes 'deploy request' (coordinator deploys)
goal: ISP (Jio) DNS returns block IP 49.44.79.236 for fapi/fstream/api.binance.com on JIS-NB and JIS-NUC; the real IP (Cloudflare DoH) serves futures klines and the stream. Operator order d-fix-binance-dns-block-1109: apply the best fix fleet-wide through the repo, no machine setting changes.
scope_out: no deploy, .mts_live, HALT, AUTO_PAUSE, process restart
sources: Lead C probe 2026-11-09: nslookup fapi.binance.com -> 49.44.79.236; DoH 54.192.142.53 -> klines OK; fstream DoH 43.206.66.18 -> 404 (server up); NUC ping FAIL both
tests: new python test file for the resolver + Java unit test for the DNS hook
title: Fleet fix: resolve Binance hosts via DNS-over-HTTPS so live futures data works on every station (ISP DNS block)
